title: W's Rehearted Arboks
description: Allows Ekans & Arbok (snake_pattern=heart) to spawn naturally.
body:
**oh my god i love heart arbok so F#CKING MUCH**

# W's Rehearted Arboks

The year as 1999. March 6, 10:00AM. Kids' WB.

Pokemans was on the telivision. Just as expected. Season 1, episode 47.

9 minutes 11 seconds into the episode. _There it is._ Heart Arbok. 2. whole. seconds. Absolute euphoria. I've been chasing the high ever since, nothing comes close.

Fast forward over 2 decades. I'm lost and without purpose. But then, I realize, Heart Arbok is in Cobblemon. I frantically boot up my computer to fill my entire PC with them.

To my utter dismay, Heart Arbok does not naturally spawn. I'm distraught, in shambles, heartbroken.

But a ray of hope shone upon me this great afternoon. My two braincells™ made contact with eachother, allowing for my monthly coherant thought.

I get to work. Scouring the Gitlab, rebuilding Cobblemon itself from the ground up, reverse engineering the mod to discover how it works. With great concentration, I did it. I have given the glorious Heart Arbok a chance to grace us all with it's presence once more...

So uhm yeag I basically just added it to the spawn pool and now it spawns like all the other ones do :)))
